programs.description: A teacher revives discipline and values by leading students in a soulful prayer. The ritual guides them from darkness to light, transforming the school into a space of spiritual learning.
Subramanyam and his family attempt to avert several problems that come their way when they move into a new house in a locality filled with bizarre individuals.
A teacher revives discipline and values by leading students in a soulful prayer. The ritual guides them from darkness to light, transforming the school into a space of spiritual learning.
Wealthy Vikram, overprotected Siddharth and ambitious orphan Aayush join a prestigious hostel. Facing fresh challenges, the trio strives to earn a coveted spot on the wall of fame.
Aaditya, Aakash and Aanand are close friends addicted to smoking and drinking. However, their wild routine takes a turn when mysterious strangers enter their circle.

After the final evening of celebration, everyone returns to work. It's revealed that Aadarsh, Aakash's elder brother, made a bold sacrifice to save him—one that ends in failure and changes everything.
Narsinh Mehta is a poet and saint of Gujarat, who is just like any other person facing several hardships and struggles in his life.
